en: The image is a sepia-toned historical photograph, likely from the late 19th or early 20th century, showing a large group of people gathered outside a building with arched windows. At the center, there appears to be a religious funeral or memorial ceremony, with an Orthodox Christian priest in traditional vestments standing behind a coffin covered in a cloth featuring crosses. Many people hold flags or banners, and there are ornate standards typical of Eastern Orthodox Christian rituals. The crowd includes men, women, and children, and two men stand on a balcony above the entrance.
